user_story: As a user, I want the system to handle an email with special characters correctly during registration so that valid edge-case emails are accepted.

positive.title: Successful registration with a valid email containing special characters
steps: Fill out the other required fields.
positive.expected_result: The user is successfully registered and redirected to the welcome page.

negative.title: Unsuccessful registration with an email containing invalid special characters
steps: Fill out the other required fields.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed stating that the email is invalid.

edge.title: Registration with an email at the maximum length limit
steps: Enter the email 'this.is.a.very.long.email.address.test@subdomain.example.com' (with valid special characters).
Fill out the other required fields.
edge.expected_result: The user is successfully registered and redirected to the welcome page.
